verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not show Granola documenting which transcription models it uses, any accuracy claims, or known transcription limits. What it documents is adjacent: audio capture via computer audio with no bot, support for 31 desktop and 17 mobile languages, and speaker tags beyond the default Me/Them labels. None of this explains how transcription works or how good it is.

support.subject: As a product manager, the vendor documents how transcription actually works and its quality (models, accuracy claims, known limits) rather than just saying "AI-powered"
